_comment: Permissions an installation token is narrowed to at mint time (POST /app/installations/{id}/access_tokens). A lane never gets more than the App's default_permissions in manifest.json. The recovery lane (crew#290/crew#300) is read-only: bin/idp-escrow and bin/idp-recover-drill clone with it and can never write to a repository. The vault-writer lane (crew#568) writes one sops file into estate-secrets from vault-seed.yml: a router virtual key for the founder's Mac, encrypted to the age recipient the repo names, so the runner never holds a decryption key.
